summary: Fresenius Medical Care AG disclosed a share buyback program via Form 6-K (EU equivalent of a share repurchase plan). The program runs from May 28, 2026 to May 27, 2027, authorizing up to 29,341,344 shares (ISIN DE0005785802) for up to EUR 1 billion. The first tranche is up to EUR 600 million until December 15, 2026. Repurchased shares will primarily be cancelled, with a small portion used for incentive plans. A credit institution makes independent trading decisions in line with EU safe-harbor rules. The company may repurchase up to 10% of share capital. Watch for execution pace and impact on share price and EPS.
